question: Which of these sentences best describe the ongoing action(s) in the video 1?
choices: Use the left hand to turn off the tap by closing the lever.
With my right hand, turn off the tap. i realised i turned on the cold water tap, so i turn it off now, as i will fill the saucepan with hot tap water to bring the pan to boil more quickly.
Turn off the tap after collecting some water in the plastic container.
Turn off the tap by closing the lever.
Turn off tap with left hand and squeeze out cloth with right hand.
